view.description: The active view (two-way): the toolbar writes the user's choice back here, and setting it switches the view.

editable.description: Week/Day: allow dragging events to move them and dragging their bottom edge to resize. The component does not persist changes — handle onChange (action 'move' / 'resize') and write back into data.events.

selectable.description: Week/Day: allow dragging over empty time to select a range, firing onSelect (use it to open your own 'new event' editor).

builtInEditor.description: When true: creating (with selectable) opens a built-in editor popover, and clicking an event (with editable) opens it pre-filled to edit or delete. Create/Save/Delete all fire onChange — you still persist the result into data.events.

showToolbar.description: Show the header toolbar (previous / next / today + the month title).

showMiniNav.description: Make the toolbar title a button that opens a mini-month navigator; click a day to jump the calendar there.

showExport.description: Show a toolbar button that downloads the loaded events as a CSV file.

locale.description: BCP-47 locale for month/weekday names (e.g. 'en-US', 'nl-NL'). Empty = browser/session default.

showWeekends.description: When false, Saturday and Sunday columns are hidden.

dayStartHour.description: Week/Day views: first hour shown on the time axis (0-24).

dayEndHour.description: Week/Day views: last hour shown on the time axis (0-24, > dayStartHour).

scrollToHour.description: Week/Day views: hour scrolled into view initially (used when scrollToNow is off or today isn't in view).

scrollToNow.description: Week/Day views: on open / view-switch / Today, centre the grid on the current time when today is in view (else fall back to scrollToHour).

refreshSeconds.description: Re-render the calendar every N seconds so the now-indicator ticks live (and 'today' stays current). 0 = off; 60 is typical.

showLegend.description: Show the category legend (bottom). Only appears when categories are defined; click an item to filter that category.

categories.description: Event categories shown in the legend. An event's colour comes from its category (matched by id) unless the event sets its own 'color'.

id.description: Category id — set an event's 'category' to this to colour it and group it under this legend item.

icon.description: Optional Ignition icon path (library/name, e.g. 'material/build') shown on this category's events and in the legend.

data.description: The events to display. Bind 'events' to a query/dataset returning the events for the visible window (see output.visibleStart/visibleEnd).

events.description: Array of event objects. Rendered in a single pass — feed the whole visible window at once rather than per-event.

id.description: Stable identifier, echoed back in onEventClick (use it for write-back).

title.description: Event label shown on the chip.

end.description: End (optional), same format as start. Exclusive for all-day multi-day events.

color.description: Chip colour (any CSS colour). Overrides the category colour; defaults to the theme accent.

category.description: Category id (see config.categories) — supplies the chip colour and the legend grouping unless 'color' is set.

status.description: Optional visual state: 'tentative' (striped/faded), 'cancelled' or 'done' (struck through). Unset renders as a normal solid event.

description.description: Optional detail text shown in the hover popover.

display.description: 'background' renders a translucent band behind events (week/day) — e.g. downtime or availability windows.

rrule.description: Optional recurrence. When set, the event repeats and is expanded per visible window.

count.description: Max number of occurrences in the series.

byweekday.description: Weekly only: weekdays to repeat on (0=Sun .. 6=Sat).

output.description: Read-only. The visible date window, so bindings can fetch only what's shown. (The active view is config.view — it's two-way.)

visibleStart.description: First date shown in the grid (ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD'). Bind your query: date >= visibleStart.

visibleEnd.description: One day past the last date shown (ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD'), half-open. Bind your query: date < visibleEnd.

hiddenCategories.description: Category ids currently hidden via the legend filter. Put a change script here to react to filtering.
